entry.name: mc.peakamp~
entry.digest: Report the maximum amplitude of a signal  (multichannel)
entry.description: Use the peakamp~ object to monitor an incoming signal and reports the absolute value of the peak amplitude of the signal it has received since the last time it was reported.

arguments.name: ms-output-interval
arguments.description: Sets the internal clock interval, in milliseconds. If it is 0, the internal clock is not used, sowill only output data when it receives a bang message. If it is non-zero,will repeatedly send out the peak amplitude received in that interval of time. By default, the interval is 0.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: In left inlet: Sends out a report of the greatest (absolute value) signal amplitude received since the previous report.

messages.name: ft1
messages.description: In right inlet: Sets the interval in milliseconds for an internal clock that triggers the automatic output of peak amplitude values from the input signal. If the interval is 0, the clock stops. If it is a positive integer, the interval changes the rate of data output. Time intervals shorter than the duration of one signal vector may be specified, but the peak amplitude will be checked only once per vector.

messages.name: in1
messages.description: In right inlet: Sets the interval in milliseconds for an internal clock that triggers the automatic output of peak amplitude values from the input signal. If the interval is 0, the clock stops. If it is a positive integer, the interval changes the rate of data output. Time intervals shorter than the duration of one signal vector may be specified, but the peak amplitude will be checked only once per vector.
